summary.business_type: Hybrid local ProfessionalService / B2B web design agency (Minneapolis)
top_findings: Mobile Lighthouse Performance 47 with LCP 6.9s (desktop 92 / LCP 1.6s)
Geo and some service templates lack JSON-LD despite strong homepage schema
Thin metas on About and Customer Success Stories
quick_wins: Self-canonical + unique title/H1 on WordPress design service page
Rewrite About and Success Stories meta descriptions
Fix 'SEO services is' grammar on SEO landing metas
Add FAQPage schema + publish llms.txt as 200 text/plain

findings.title: Heavy homepage HTML and script count
findings.description: Homepage HTML ~568 KB with 33 script tags; cf-cache-status DYNAMIC.
findings.recommendation: Defer non-critical JS, audit third-party tags, enable anonymous HTML caching where safe.

findings.title: wp-login.php publicly reachable
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare WAF rate limit / CAPTCHA on wp-login; enforce 2FA.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Trustindex Google reviews on success stories page

findings.title: Founding year inconsistency
findings.description: Schema foundingDate year 2007 vs some external/about cues of 2004.
findings.recommendation: Standardize one founding year across site, schema, and directories.

findings.title: Large blog corpus needs hygiene
findings.description: 233 post URLs in sitemaps including older technical posts.
findings.recommendation: Audit for thin/outdated posts; noindex or consolidate; refresh money pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Homepage title/meta/H1 aligned to Minneapolis web design
Self-canonicals on home, about, contact, Minneapolis SEO

findings.title: Service page canonicalized to homepage
findings.description: /wordpress-website-design-services/ returns 200 but canonical and title match the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Unique title, meta, H1, and self-referencing canonical on that URL.

findings.title: Dual H1 on SEO services hub
findings.recommendation: Keep one H1; demote the second to H2.

findings.title: Thin meta descriptions
findings.description: About meta is 'About Us'; Success Stories meta is 'Customer Success Stories'.

findings.title: GeoCoordinates longitude leading space
findings.description: longitude value includes a leading space in JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Trim to a clean numeric string in Rank Math / custom schema.

findings.title: Missing JSON-LD on geo templates
findings.description: Minneapolis SEO and similar geo pages lack ProfessionalService JSON-LD.
findings.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService + areaServed on geo landings.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS good on mobile and desktop

findings.title: Mobile LCP 6.9s / Performance 47
findings.description: Lighthouse mobile: LCP 6870ms, TBT 910ms, ~2.8 MiB transfer; PSI rate-limited so no field CrUX this run.
findings.recommendation: Reduce JS bootup (Splide, HubSpot, Clarity, GTM), optimize LCP image, defer third parties.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Search-oriented AI crawlers returned 200 in GEO tests

findings.title: llms.txt unavailable (403)
findings.description: /llms.txt and variants returned 403 HTML, not a plain-text discovery file.
findings.recommendation: Publish text/plain llms.txt summarizing services, NAP, and key URLs.

findings.title: No FAQ / answer-first homepage structure
findings.description: Homepage is narrative; no FAQPage schema for citability.
findings.recommendation: Add short direct-answer FAQs on Home and SEO Services with FAQPage JSON-LD.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Homepage 12 images with 0 missing alt attributes

findings.title: Image weight still a mobile opportunity
findings.description: Lighthouse estimated ~774 KB image delivery savings on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Serve properly sized AVIF/WebP; lazy-load below-fold images.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: Consistent phone and address across footer and homepage schema
Google Maps embed with place context

findings.title: No GBP URL in Organization sameAs
findings.description: sameAs lists social profiles but not Google Business Profile.
findings.recommendation: Add Maps / g.page URL to sameAs; keep NAP identical to GBP.

findings.title: Reviews without AggregateRating schema
findings.description: Trustindex Google reviews on success stories; no review structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add eligible review/aggregate markup or clear GBP link with visible rating.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix WordPress design page canonical and unique on-page
Single H1 + grammar fixes on SEO services

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: GBP in sameAs; review schema; fix geo longitude

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Rank tracking for Minneapolis agency terms
